Home.b2: Power Automate + Copilot Studio: automations, approvals, integrations, and Copilot/agents connected across the ecosystem.

Home.aboutIntro1: I’m Tom Kelve, a Senior Solution Architect and hands-on developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise solutions in Power Platform and Azure, integrating Dynamics 365 and critical corporate systems.
Home.aboutIntro2: I work end-to-end, from discovery and architectural blueprint (C4/L0–L4) to production delivery, integration, observability and continuous improvement. Strong experience with Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven) and Dataverse, orchestrating processes with Power Automate, building external experiences with Power Pages and delivering analytics with Power BI. On Azure, I design API-first and event-driven architectures using Service Bus, Functions, Logic Apps, Event Grid and API Management/APISIX, applying idempotency, retry/backoff, DLQ and end-to-end tracing. I also work with applied AI using Copilot, Azure OpenAI, AI Builder and Azure AI Foundry.
Home.aboutStack: Stack: Power Apps (Canvas + Model-driven), Power Automate, Power Pages, Power BI, Dataverse, Dynamics 365 and Azure (Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, Logic Apps, AKS, APISIX/APIM).
Home.logoStripSubtitle: Experience in enterprise environments and critical operations across industry, energy, retail, logistics and finance/healthcare.
Home.aboutS1Desc: Scalable apps with Dataverse, reusable components, process-driven UX, business rules and performance.
Home.aboutS2Desc: Cloud flows, approvals and process orchestration; integration with APIs, webhooks, Service Bus and enterprise connectors.
Home.aboutS3Desc: External experiences with authentication, roles/profiles, forms, Dataverse permissions and security patterns.
Home.aboutS4Desc: Modeling, DAX, RLS, performance and executive dashboards for operations and decision-making.
Home.aboutS5Desc: APISIX/APIM, Azure Functions, Event Grid, Logic Apps and Service Bus for resilient, scalable integrations.
Home.aboutS6Desc: CoE/guardrails, environments, DLP, CI/CD, idempotency, DLQ, observability, SLOs and predictable operations.
Home.aboutBody: I’m Tom Kelve, an Azure & Power Platform Solution Architect and hands-on developer with 5+ years of experience in Power Platform, Azure, Dynamics 365, enterprise integration, data, automation and applied AI.
Home.aboutBody2: I cover discovery and architectural blueprint through implementation, integration, observability, continuous optimization and technical standardization, focusing on governance, security, performance and operational predictability.
Home.diff1Desc: From blueprint to production. I design, implement and operate solutions with real-world performance, security and observability standards.
Home.diff2Desc: True API-first and event-driven. Clear contracts, versioning, end-to-end traceability and well-governed messaging.
Home.diff3Desc: Reliability as a requirement, not an add-on. Idempotency, retry/backoff, DLQ, controlled reprocessing and failure-first design.
Home.diff4Desc: Environments under control, changes without drama. Pipelines, standards, environment management and quality to evolve safely.
Home.diff5Desc: Data into decisions. Modeling, performance and insights with Power BI and Fabric, connecting ingestion → semantic layer → consumption.
Home.diff6Desc: Copilots with limits and value. Security, policies, traceability and intelligent automations with Copilot, Azure OpenAI and AI Builder.
